description.value: PISE is a non-profit sport and physical literacy institute located in Victoria, BC, and is recognized as the first summer sport institute in Canada. It offers a broad range of programs for all ages and abilities, including a dedicated 'Kids on Wheels' cycling program, a performance fitness centre, and a 4-lane indoor track. Families on cycling tours with children interested in a structured bike skills program may find it a worthwhile stop.
